connector.name: Webcake Landing
connector.registryDescription: Build, validate, and persist Webcake landing-page source JSON: element schemas plus AI usage hints.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.toolvn.io.vn over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package webcake-landing-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vuluu2k account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Webcake JWT>; required only for the persistence tools (create/update/list pages).

env.name: WEBCAKE_JWT
env.description: Webcake backend JWT; required only for the persistence tools (create/update/list pages).

env.name: WEBCAKE_ENV
env.description: Webcake environment preset that fills the API/app/builder base URLs.

env.name: WEBCAKE_API_BASE
env.description: Override for the Webcake API base URL (takes precedence over WEBCAKE_ENV).

env.name: WEBCAKE_ORG_ID
env.description: Default Webcake organization id for the persistence tools.

env.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Pexels API key for search_images; without one a shared hosted proxy is used.
